# The committed test frames (docs/port/TESTING_FIXTURES.md): a line a fixture,
#   NAME SOURCE [rules=FILE] [PROPERTY...]
# NAME the file NAME.rdfix in this folder; SOURCE the dump it was made from,
# by its name below the sources folder (the developer's machine-local copy of
# the source dumps, ICO_FIXTURE_SOURCES; never in the repository); FILE a
# texture rule file in this folder (none: the default rules); PROPERTY what
# the fixture is meant to carry, QUANTITY OP VALUE (rd_fixture_helpers.cmake's
# quantities), checked against the replays of every test that names it.
# Regenerate: rd_fixture_tool remake fixtures.txt <sources> <this folder>.
# A property holds at the settings its tests check it at: date_snapshots where
# DATE takes the R8 snapshot and date_stencil_draws where it takes the stencil
# bit (the composites' own, before the shadow cuts), date_one_shared,
# empty_composites_skipped, no_volume_kept and no_volume_break_taken on the run
# with that cut on (the last two where DATE takes the stencil bit: a snapshot
# setting takes no window), stencil_window_stores with ICO_RD_STENCIL_PACKED=0.
# date_cut_passes on the run with the cut on where it acts (DATE by the
# snapshot, a whole scale: not at the phone's fractional one); shadow_levels and
# shadow_level_texels on the default run above 1x (and the forced one at 1x).
# lamps_fillpaste_fills on the run with ICO_RD_LAMPS=pad+owed+wholepad+lowres+
# fillpaste at the PowerVR phone's setting, the cull off (ICO_RD_CULL=off, the
# lamps list's nocull word) where it is >=1: the generated lamps are in the
# glow's chain only then.
# present_scene_skipped on the run with ICO_RD_PRESENT_SCENE=1 at the PowerVR
# phone's setting (=0: the reduction kept there, the main gate's open border).
#
# stage 4, the Pixel 10 Pro Fold's F12 frame (v0.11.4): a character's shadow
# (seven volume commands, the count, three levels, three composites) at 21:9
